units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 34:4">Targ. Is. XXXIV, 4</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Chullin 47b:1">Ḥull. 47ᵇ</cite> <he>ט׳ דאסא</he> leaf of a myrtle; a. fr.—
Nidd. 20ᵃ ט׳ מציעתא fem. (Rashi: מציעא), v. infra.—Trnsf. ט׳ דנחירי wing of the nose.
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 3:7">Targ. Gen. III, 7</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Sukkah 37b:2">Succ. 37ᵇ</cite> <he>נתרי ט׳</he> leaves may fall off.

<cite ref="Shabbat 129a:16">Sabb. 129ᵃ</cite> <he>חמרא בר הלתא ט׳</he> Rashi (ed. <cite ref="B01377"><he>בת</he></cite>) wine of a vine that has changed foliage three times, i.e. wine in its third year. Nidd. l. c. <he>טַרְפָן</he> fem., v. <cite ref="D01026"><he>דָּרָא</he> I</cite>.

<cite ref="Berakhot 59a">Ber. 59ᵃ</cite> top, and it looks <he>כט׳ דטריף</he> like an irregular piece that has been torn off (from the star); Rashi: like a battered piece that has been mended by hammering; (Ms. F. <he>ומתחזי דמיטרפא מיטרף</he> you can see that it has been torn off, Vers. in Rashi: <he>כדטרפא מטרף</he>, prob. to be read <he>כטרפא דמְטַרַף</he>).
